articles.title: GHSA: PyJWT: Malformed RSA JWK aborts parsing of an entire JWK Set
articles.summary:
## Summary

A malformed RSA JWK inside a JWK Set aborts parsing of the entire set instead of being skipped, because `RSAAlgorithm.from_jwk` can raise a plain `ValueError` that isn't caught by `PyJWKSet`'s per-key error-skipping logic.

articles.title: GHSA: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via unrequested WebSocket subprotocol
articles.summary:
### Impact

The undici WebSocket client throws an uncaught `TypeError` during the opening handshake when a server's `101` response includes a `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` header that the client never requested. articles.title: GHSA: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via unbounded decompression of compressed responses
articles.summary:
### Impact

The `interceptors.decompress()` interceptor decompresses HTTP response bodies according to the untrusted `Content-Encoding` header. The number of decompression layers is capped at 5, but the total decompressed output size is not bounded and there is no option to limit it. articles.summary:
